title: A-S 547 - Digital Media Projects Capstone
prerequisites: ART 302, Senior Standing, B.S. Digital Media and Design Majors
repeatability: Repeatable to a maximum of 9A culminating course that allows digital media students to propose and create large-scale, in-depth projects such as short films, video installations, a complete animation, a photographic series, a 3D printing installation, a web-based research project, etc.
